hypotheses.reasoning: A brief auth-svc-3 restart (capacity 3/4) was a survivable blip. It recovered at #197. account-svc's AuthClient then retried immediately with backoff disabled, up to 4 attempts. That pushed auth-svc to 3-5x baseline inflight, so it kept shedding load with 503 even at full capacity. account-svc returned 503 to edge-proxy, which surfaced as 503s on /login. The retry storm sustains the outage.
Retry backoff disabled looks like a misconfiguration that allowed the amplification.

verdict.recommendedAction: Re-enable exponential backoff with jitter in account-svc AuthClient and add a retry budget. Temporarily throttle login traffic or restart account-svc to break the storm so auth-svc can drain its queue. Then investigate why auth-svc-3 failed its liveness probe.
